definition_zh: 永久地；永远地；长期地；不可逆地
definition_en: in a way that lasts for a very long time or for ever, in a settled long-term arrangement, or in a way that cannot be undone
core_image: 钉子已经钉进木头，就算拔出来也会留下一个洞
scene: 搬家那天，他把旧钥匙放在桌上，决定不再回来。The family left the village permanently in the spring.
sceneCN: 这里是「永久地、永远地」（第 1 个义项：长时间不再改变）；句意为这家人春天永久地离开了村子。

pos.zh: 永久地；永远地；长期地；不可逆地

derivatives.zh: 拉丁语 permanens 进入英语，义为「永久的；长期的」
permanent 加名词后缀 -ence，义为「永久性；持久」
permanent 加 -ency，义为「永久；永久的事物」，比 permanence 少见
与 permanent 同出拉丁语 manere（停留），义为「留下；保持」

senses.title: For ever, not for a short time
senses.definition: in a way that lasts for ever, or for the whole period being considered, rather than a short while
senses.definitionCN: 以一种永远持续、或在所考虑的整个期间都持续的方式，而不是短时间
senses.example: The old cinema closed permanently last winter.
senses.exampleCN: 那家老电影院去年冬天永久关闭了。
senses.why: Per- adds the idea of through to manere, to remain, so the word starts from remaining all the way through instead of stopping partway.
senses.whyCN: per- 给 manere（停留）加上了「贯穿到底」的意思，所以这个词的起点是一直留到最后，而不是半途停下。

senses.title: As a settled, long-term arrangement
senses.definition: in a fixed and lasting arrangement, rather than in a temporary or trial position
senses.definitionCN: 以固定的、长久有效的安排，而不是临时或试用的状态
senses.example: After two years on short contracts, he was finally employed permanently.
senses.exampleCN: 签了两年短期合同之后，他终于被长期聘用。
senses.why: Once the word names what does not stop, it also describes arrangements meant to stay in place, so a job or a home can be held permanently.
senses.whyCN: 既然这个词能指「不停下来的东西」，它也能指有意长期维持的安排，于是一份工作或一处住所都可以被长期保有。

senses.title: Irreversibly, with no way back
senses.definition: in a way that cannot be undone or reversed, so the earlier state is gone for good
senses.definitionCN: 以无法撤销或逆转的方式，先前的状态从此消失
senses.example: The flood permanently changed the shape of the river.
senses.exampleCN: 那场洪水永久地改变了这条河的走向。
senses.why: Something that remains to the very end leaves no point at which it could be turned back, which is why the word also marks damage or change that can never be repaired.
senses.whyCN: 一件事一直持续到最后，就没有留下任何可以回头的时刻，所以这个词也用来标记再也修不回来的损坏或改变。

intro.en: Permanently is an English adverb built on a Latin verb of remaining: a prefix of through, a verb meaning to stay, and a suffix of manner.
intro.cn: permanently 是建立在拉丁语「停留」动词上的英语副词：一个表示「贯穿」的前缀、一个意为「停留」的动词，加一个表示方式的后缀。

items.en: Latin manere meant to stay or to remain, and it is the source of several English words about staying put.
items.cn: 拉丁语 manere 意为「停留、留下」，是若干表示「待着不动」的英语词的来源。

items.en: The prefix per- added the sense of through, giving permanere, to remain to the end or to endure.
items.cn: 前缀 per- 补上「贯穿」的意思，构成 permanere，意为「留到最后、持续下去」。

items.en: The present participle permanens, with the stem permanent-, described something that keeps on remaining.
items.cn: 现在分词 permanens 的词干为 permanent-，用来形容一直停留、持续存在的东西。

items.en: English took permanent from Latin and French, at first as an adjective meaning lasting or unchanged.
items.cn: 英语经拉丁语与法语借入 permanent，最初作形容词，意为「持久的、不变的」。

items.en: The adverb added -ly to permanent, and it now covers for ever, for the long term, and beyond repair.
items.cn: 副词形式在 permanent 后加 -ly，如今覆盖「永远」「长期」与「无法修复」三种用法。

note.en: The look-alike group collects words on the Latin verb of remaining; the near-meaning group collects expressions for time without an end.
note.cn: 形近组收建立在拉丁语「停留」动词上的词；近义组收表示「没有终点的时间」的说法。

entries.definition: Lasting for a long time or for ever, not temporary.
entries.definitionCN: 长久或永久持续的，不是临时的。

entries.definition: The state of lasting for ever or for a long time.
entries.definitionCN: 永久或长久持续的状态。

entries.definition: To stay in the same place or condition.
entries.definitionCN: 留在原处或保持原状。

entries.definition: A small part left after the rest has gone.
entries.definitionCN: 其余部分消失后留下的一小部分。

entries.definition: For all time, with no end.
entries.definitionCN: 永远，没有尽头。

entries.definition: For a period with no fixed end.
entries.definitionCN: 没有固定期限地；无限期地。

entries.definition: For ever, in a way that will not change back.
entries.definitionCN: 永远地，不会再变回去。

entries.definition: Lasting through all time, often in a lofty or religious tone.
entries.definitionCN: 永恒地，常带庄重或宗教色彩。

normalIntro.en: The word is a Latin verb of staying, pushed through by a prefix, then turned into an adverb of manner.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词由拉丁语「停留」动词加上一个表示「贯穿」的前缀，再变成表示方式的副词。

normal.en: Per- means through and manere means to remain, so the pair says to remain through to the end.
normal.cn: per- 意为「贯穿」，manere 意为「停留」，两者合起来就是「一直留到最后」。

normal.en: Permanent is the adjective, and -ly turns it into the adverb without changing the meaning.
normal.cn: permanent 是形容词，加 -ly 变成副词，意思并不改变。

normal.en: Remain and remnant come from the same Latin verb manere, which is why they feel related.
normal.cn: remain 与 remnant 同出拉丁语动词 manere，所以它们读起来有亲缘感。

normal.en: The natural opposite is temporarily, and most collocations set the two against each other.
normal.cn: 它天然的反义词是 temporarily，多数搭配都把两者对立起来。

normal.en: Permanently deleted and permanently closed both mean there is no undo button.
normal.cn: permanently deleted 与 permanently closed 都意味着没有撤销键。

abstract.en: Picture a nail driven flush into wood: even if you pull it out, the hole stays and the surface is never flat again.
abstract.cn: 想象一枚钉子被敲得与木面齐平：就算拔出来，洞还在，表面再也平不回去。

abstract.en: The word is a door with its key thrown away, which is why it fits damage better than it fits furniture.
abstract.cn: 这个词像一扇把钥匙扔掉的门，所以它更适合形容损坏，而不适合形容家具。

abstract.en: Two ideas share one word: time that does not end, and a decision that does not turn back.
abstract.cn: 两种想法共用一个词：不会结束的时间，和不会回头的决定。

examples.en: The library is permanently closed for repairs.
examples.cn: 图书馆因维修永久关闭。

examples.en: She moved permanently to the coast after retiring.
examples.cn: 退休后她永久搬到了海边。

examples.en: The injury left him permanently unable to lift his arm.
examples.cn: 那次受伤让他再也抬不起手臂。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「泼墨能特利」——墨泼到纸上就再也收不回，一泼便是永久；记住 permanently 是永久地。

root: 拉丁语 permanere（持续停留）的现在分词 permanens（词干 permanent-）进入英语作 permanent，再加 -ly 构成；per-（贯穿）加 manere（停留）。

sensesIntro.en: The core sense is remaining all the way to the end; the senses then split into endless time, settled arrangements and changes that cannot be undone.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心义是一直留到最后；义项由此分为没有尽头的时间、长期固定的安排，以及无法撤销的改变。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a nail driven flush into wood, leaving a hole that never closes.
core.cn: 核心意象：一枚钉子被敲进木头，留下一个再也合不上的洞。

branches.en: a cinema with its shutters down for good
branches.cn: 卷帘门永远拉下的电影院

branches.en: a key left on a table after moving day
branches.cn: 搬家后留在桌上的钥匙

branches.en: a contract with no end date
branches.cn: 没有截止日期的合同

branches.en: a river bed cut into a new shape
branches.cn: 被冲出全新走向的河床

branches.en: a scar that stays after the cut heals
branches.cn: 伤口愈合后仍留下的疤

intro.en: The word is a Latin verb of staying under a prefix of through, then an English adverb ending that marks manner.
intro.cn: 这个词是拉丁语「停留」动词加上「贯穿」前缀，再加英语中标记方式的副词词尾。

latinIntro.en: All of the core pieces are Latin: the prefix per-, the verb manere, and the participle permanens.
latinIntro.cn: 核心部件全部来自拉丁语：前缀 per-、动词 manere，以及分词 permanens。
